Class Hero

java.lang.Object
model.Hero
public class Hero extends Object
Represents the player hero in the game. The hero has statistics such as HP, armor, protection, energy points, mana, experience, level, boost damage, and effects. This class provides methods to manipulate and update these stats, including adding or subtracting values, resetting temporary buffs, and managing status effects.

    • add

      public void add(String string, int value)
      Adds a value to one of the hero's attributes. Automatically handles HP overflow and leveling up if XP exceeds maxXP.
      Parameters:
      string - Name of the attribute (hp, maxHP, protection, armor, energy, mana, xp, curse)
      value - Amount to add

    • sub

      public void sub(String string, int value)
      Subtracts a value from one of the hero's attributes. Damage is first applied to protection, then to HP if needed.
      Parameters:
      string - Name of the attribute (hp, maxHP, protection, armor, energy, mana)
      value - Amount to subtract
